plan.concept: Demonstration of 2D scaling transformation on a rectangle using a 3x3 homogeneous coordinate matrix
plan.layout: Vertical layout containing a 2D coordinate system with a rectangle at the top, the title 'Scaling' in the middle, and the homogeneous scaling matrix equation at the bottom.

series.label: Scaled Rectangle
series.note: A filled green rectangle representing the scaled geometry centered at the origin, with a dark gray outline (#3A3D40).

annotations.text: \begin{bmatrix} x' \\ y' \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} s_x & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & s_y & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}

plan.colorScheme: White background, dark charcoal/black axes and text, bright green fill (#3BFF13) for the transformed geometry with a dark gray (#3A3D40) border.
plan.reconstructionNotes: To faithfully reconstruct this graphic, ensure a vertical flow layout. The top half should feature the 2D coordinate system with black coordinate axes ending in triangular arrowheads. The origin should be central, with the green rectangle centered at (0,0) with an aspect ratio of roughly 2.16:1.
